decision_clarity-1: PLAN.md:49 (W-3 'bounded lease polling') · PLAN.md:65 — REQUEST.md:55 requires '대기 상한은 launcher 설정 키로 두되 코드 기본값을 갖는다', but the PLAN does not fix the setting key name, the default timeout or the polling interval. decision_clarity-2: PLAN.md:46 (W-1) · PLAN.md:35 — The PLAN decides to preserve terminal_creation and observed_lease_owner on the recovery_required transition and to allow only the recover path for recovery_required→hub_owned. It does not fix the ownership-set CLI interface: the argument names/form for passing terminal_creation and observed_lease_owner, and how worktree-tool tells a recover-path call apart from other callers. It also leaves open the response field names for recover's '미확인 항목'. And W-3 changes only orca.py while the adapters/ directory has no common base (cmux.py, generic.py, opal_agent_fallback.py are separate), so how the other adapters return 'unknown(status_unsupported)' (launcher_core hasattr fallback vs. stubs in each adapter) is also open. W-1 and W-3 are split across P1/P2, so the implementer has to choose these CLI arguments, response fields and unsupported-adapter mechanism.

advisories.basis: S-6 runs both pytest and a real Codex sandbox (`pytest / 두 도구 및 실제 Codex sandbox`). The test itself is a 구현 전 RED test. Its contract has three parts: lock `os.open` EPERM/EACCES/EROFS becomes `registry_write_denied` with no 30-second wait; codex-start returns ok with the `registry_owner_deferred_to_hub` diagnostic only when the lease claim succeeded but the registry write was denied; a foreign owner fails. pytest with an injected errno and a fake lease proves all three from the recorded results. The real-sandbox boot that triggers this path is already covered by S-9 (covers AC-4 and C-1, runs on the installed copy with real Orca/Codex, and expects codex-start ok). S-6 has no `[실호출 1회]` marker, and its AC (AC-4) does not judge model output quality.
advisories.recommendation: Limit S-6's method and environment column to `pytest / worktree-tool·ownership-tool` and drop the real Codex sandbox part. If the real sandbox errno needs observing, record the observed errno and the `registry_owner_deferred_to_hub` diagnostic as an extra expected result in S-9.
